Cuppers

Cuppers results

How to report results and request an extension or review.

On this page
Report a resultRequest an extensionRequest a reviewContact the Cuppers Director

Please report each Cuppers result promptly so the draw can be updated and the competition can continue on schedule.

Report a result

Email the Cuppers Director with your Oxford email address if different from the address you are using, the winning and losing team IDs, the score, and any relevant comments.

Email the Cuppers Director

Request an extension

Ask for an extension before the existing deadline. Include both team IDs, the date requested, and the reason.

Request an extension

Request a review

If a dispute requires a decision by the Cuppers Director, send the team IDs and a concise explanation of the issue.

Request a review

Contact the Cuppers Director

For other Cuppers questions, email 2026croquetcuppers@gmail.com.
